item.tib: stag la me 'bar phyi nang gsang gsum gyi lag len gsal ba
item.coloph: lag len gsal byed snum lce 'di/ ci par rad na'i gsung sgrub phyir/ ku su mu la ldom bu bas/ yos lo bsgyur byed la ni sbyar/ skya ring nu bo thabs sras rgyud/ ma rtogs phyogs rigs skal dman sde/ slob dpon gsang zhing rang che 'byin/ yon tan 'gos bru thabs kyis len/ ngo gnyis rgyal mtshan rtse la phyar/ rno thos bon la ngom tshig gtong*/ sger bu rang mthong g.yag rke ni/ man ngag shod mas 'debs pa'i grogs/ de 'dra'i sgra 'dzin gzugs 'dzin la/ bon dang gsal bar gyur pa na/ gnyis ka du ti'i du kha sbyongs/ ding par 'o ma 'di nyid kyang gser snod byung na brgya la yang lug (blug) go/ kha snod gcig la'ang blug mi bya//
